export.title: Export
export.layoutSingle: Single page (all columns on one page)
export.subtitle: Download your flight data in various formats
export.csvDescription: Export all flights as a CSV file. Choose a column format for your authority.
export.jsonDescription: Export everything — flights, aircraft, licenses, class ratings, and credentials as a JSON backup file.
export.pdfDescription: Generate a formatted logbook PDF. Print it, sign it, and use it as a paper logbook.
export.importDescription: Import flights from ForeFlight, CSV files, or other logbook exports. Auto-detects format and column mapping.
aboutItems: CSV Standard — ForeFlight-compatible with all flight fields. Opens in Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet app.
CSV EASA — AMC1 FCL.050 column layout (24 columns: SP-SE/ME, Multi-Pilot, PIC Name, Co-Pilot, Instructor, FSTD).
CSV FAA — ASA/Jeppesen standard logbook columns with decimal hours.
PDF EASA — Full AMC1 FCL.050 compliant logbook with SP-SE/ME split, FSTD sessions, and page totals.
PDF FAA — Standard ASA/Jeppesen layout with approaches, holds, and IPC/Flight Review markers.
JSON Backup — Complete data snapshot including aircraft fleet, licenses with class ratings, and credentials.
Your data is yours — export anytime, no restrictions, no fees.
